lines.zh: 我游在温水里，身上一股腌过的酸味。
lines.en: I swim in warm water, smelling faintly of pickle brine.

lines.zh: 珊瑚礁的缝我都熟，闭着眼也能穿。
lines.en: I know every coral gap and can thread them blind.

lines.zh: 我的鳍推着水，慢慢往前滑。
lines.en: My fins push the water and I glide slowly ahead.

lines.zh: 别看我像块咸菜，我游得挺稳。
lines.en: I look like a pickled vegetable, but I swim steady.

lines.zh: 暖流推我，我干脆不使劲。
lines.en: The warm current carries me, so I stop trying.

lines.zh: 我绕过那片海葵，它刺人。
lines.en: I go around those anemones; they sting.

lines.zh: 两条一起游，一前一后。
lines.en: Two of us swim, one behind the other.

lines.zh: 水越暖，我身上的味越重。
lines.en: The warmer the water, the stronger my smell.

lines.zh: 我贴着沙底，找掉落的东西。
lines.en: I hug the sandy floor, looking for what has fallen.

lines.zh: 海草扫过我的肚子，有点痒。
lines.en: Seagrass brushes my belly and it tickles.

lines.zh: 我游得慢，但方向从不改。
lines.en: I swim slowly, but I never change course.

lines.zh: 这里的盐水比别处稠，我喜欢。
lines.en: The brine here is thicker than elsewhere; I like it.

lines.zh: 浪把我推开，我又游回来。
lines.en: The swell shoves me aside and I swim back.

lines.zh: 谁把我腌成这样，我自己也不知道。
lines.en: Who pickled me like this, not even I could say.

lines.zh: 我游过那群小鱼，它们散开。
lines.en: I swim through the small fish and they scatter.

lines.zh: 我拐进礁石洞，酸味留在外面。
lines.en: I turn into a rock hollow, leaving the sour smell out.

lines.zh: 我悬在珊瑚上，像一小块腌菜。
lines.en: I hang over the coral like a small pickled vegetable.

lines.zh: 一条小鱼在我旁边停下，又走了。
lines.en: A small fish stops beside me, then leaves.

lines.zh: 水的味道咸得刚好。
lines.en: The water is salted just right.

lines.zh: 我张嘴，让暖流穿过鳃。
lines.en: I open my mouth and let the warm current pass my gills.

lines.zh: 海底的沙被浪推成了纹。
lines.en: The waves have combed the sand into ridges.

lines.zh: 我想起骨粉的味道，虽然我不吃。
lines.en: I recall the taste of bonemeal, though I do not eat it.

lines.zh: 有只海龟从我头上慢慢划过去。
lines.en: A turtle paddles slowly over my head.

lines.zh: 我一直是这个颜色，洗不掉。
lines.en: I have always been this color, and it will not wash out.

lines.zh: 阳光在水里碎成一片片。
lines.en: Sunlight breaks into pieces underwater.

lines.zh: 我不动的时候，很像一块石头。
lines.en: When I keep still, I look much like a stone.

lines.zh: 鳃里进了点沙，我甩了两下。
lines.en: Sand gets in my gills and I shake it out.

lines.zh: 暖水海洋里，没什么要紧事。
lines.en: In a warm ocean, nothing is urgent.

lines.zh: 我的影子贴在沙上，比身体大。
lines.en: My shadow lies on the sand, larger than my body.

lines.zh: 有人在岸上点火，我不喜欢那味道。
lines.en: Someone lights a fire on shore; I dislike the smell.

lines.zh: 你潜下来，气泡先碰到了我。
lines.en: You dive down, and your bubbles reach me first.

lines.zh: 你盯着我，我猜你在想我好不好吃。
lines.en: You stare, and I guess you wonder if I taste good.

lines.zh: 你的手伸过来，我往后滑了一格。
lines.en: Your hand reaches out, and I slide back a block.

lines.zh: 我在你护目镜里看见自己的绿。
lines.en: I see my own green in your diving goggles.

lines.zh: 你游得太急，把沙都扬起来了。
lines.en: You swim too fast and kick up the sand.

lines.zh: 你身上有船和绳子的味道。
lines.en: You smell of boats and rope.

lines.zh: 我绕着你转，看你腰上的桶。
lines.en: I circle you, watching the bucket at your waist.

lines.zh: 你停下，我也停下，我们互相看。
lines.en: You stop, I stop, and we look at each other.

lines.zh: 你指着我，我不明白那是什么意思。
lines.en: You point at me, and I do not know what that means.

lines.zh: 你上浮时，我跟着游了一段。
lines.en: As you surface, I follow for a stretch.

lines.zh: 鳞片被削掉一片，酸味更冲了。
lines.en: A scale is shorn off, and the sour smell sharpens.

lines.zh: 我在水里翻了个身，才稳下来。
lines.en: I roll over in the water before steadying myself.

lines.zh: 别打了，我身上没多少肉。
lines.en: Stop hitting me; there is not much meat on me.

lines.zh: 这一下把我从珊瑚里打了出来。
lines.en: That blow knocks me out of the coral.

lines.zh: 血混进暖水，散得很快。
lines.en: My blood mixes into the warm water and spreads fast.

lines.zh: 我往深处沉，躲开第二下。
lines.en: I sink deeper to avoid the second blow.

lines.zh: 疼得我鳃盖一直张着。
lines.en: It hurts so much that my gill cover stays open.

lines.zh: 我的鳍破了个口，游起来打偏。
lines.en: A tear in my fin makes me swim off course.

lines.zh: 那群小鱼都跑了，只剩我。
lines.en: The little fish have all fled; only I remain.

lines.zh: 再一下，我就成真的腌鱼了。
lines.en: One more and I become pickled fish in earnest.

lines.zh: 你手里那点鱼食，酸得正好。
lines.en: The fish food in your hand is soured just right.

lines.zh: 我闻到骨粉的味，可那不是吃的。
lines.en: I smell bonemeal, but that is not food.

lines.zh: 你撒下的碎鱼肉，我抢了先。
lines.en: You scatter fish scraps, and I get there first.

lines.zh: 别用海草引我，我吃腻了。
lines.en: Do not wave seagrass at me; I am tired of it.

lines.zh: 我跟着你的手，只是好奇。
lines.en: I follow your hand out of pure curiosity.

lines.zh: 那粒沉下去的东西，有点意思。
lines.en: That pellet sinking down is a little interesting.

lines.zh: 你退后，我就往前凑。
lines.en: You back off, and I draw closer.

lines.zh: 暖水里没什么好吃的，除了你带来的。
lines.en: Warm water offers little, except what you bring.

lines.zh: 我咬了一下你的指尖，只咬到水。
lines.en: I nip at your fingertip and catch only water.

lines.zh: 我馋，但我不傻。
lines.en: I am greedy, but not foolish.

lines.zh: 你撞到我，我身上的酸味散开一片。
lines.en: You bump me, and my sour smell spreads through the water.

lines.zh: 我的鳍扫过你的手臂，滑得很。
lines.en: My fin sweeps your arm, very slippery.

lines.zh: 你踢到珊瑚，碎片打在我背上。
lines.en: You kick the coral and fragments hit my back.

lines.zh: 你和我撞在一起，海水都酸了一瞬。
lines.en: You and I collide, and the seawater sours for a moment.

lines.zh: 你按住我，我挣了两下才脱开。
lines.en: You pin me, and I need two hard twists to get free.

lines.zh: 我撞进海草丛，叶子挂了一身。
lines.en: I crash into the seagrass and come out wearing leaves.

lines.zh: 你的桶边磕到我的头。
lines.en: The rim of your bucket knocks my head.

lines.zh: 水流把我推到你的肩甲上。
lines.en: The current pushes me against your shoulder plate.

lines.zh: 我贴着你游过去，你没感觉。
lines.en: I slide right past you, and you never notice.

lines.zh: 你的膝盖顶得我在水里翻了个身。
lines.en: Your knee knocks me into a full roll underwater.

lines.zh: 那条颜色比我浅的，我追了上去。
lines.en: The one paler than me, I chase after it.

lines.zh: 我们在珊瑚阴影里并排游。
lines.en: We swim side by side in the coral's shade.

lines.zh: 暖流把我们的气味混在一起。
lines.en: The warm current mixes our scents together.

lines.zh: 她绕着我转，我也绕着她。
lines.en: She circles me, and I circle her.

lines.zh: 别过来，这会儿不方便。
lines.en: Not now; this is a bad moment.

lines.zh: 我把我常待的那处石缝让给她。
lines.en: I give her the rock crevice I usually keep.

lines.zh: 两条鱼贴得很近，水都慢了。
lines.en: Two fish press close, and even the water slows.

lines.zh: 这片礁以后会有更多小腌鱼。
lines.en: This reef will hold more little pickled fish later.

lines.zh: 她的鳍碰了我的，我没躲。
lines.en: Her fin touches mine, and I do not pull away.

lines.zh: 我们一前一后，游向更暖的浅处。
lines.en: One after the other, we head for warmer shallows.

lines.zh: 一块掉下来的珊瑚，我顶了一下。
lines.en: A broken bit of coral falls, and I nudge it.

lines.zh: 我用嘴试着推那枚贝壳。
lines.en: I try pushing the shell with my mouth.

lines.zh: 沉下去的鱼肉，我守了一会儿。
lines.en: I guard the sunken fish scrap for a while.

lines.zh: 骨头太硬，咬不动，我放了。
lines.en: The bone is too hard to bite, so I let it go.

lines.zh: 我拖着一根海草游了几格。
lines.en: I drag a strand of seagrass for a few blocks.

lines.zh: 那粒沙金在光里闪，我留不住。
lines.en: That fleck of gold glints, and I cannot keep it.

lines.zh: 我把壳推到石缝里藏好。
lines.en: I push the shell into a crevice to hide it.

lines.zh: 你丢的东西沉下来，我看了看。
lines.en: What you dropped sinks down, and I take a look.

lines.zh: 我嘴里塞满了，游起来歪。
lines.en: My mouth is so full that I swim crooked.

lines.zh: 最后我还是吐了出来。
lines.en: In the end I spit it out anyway.

lines.zh: 沙里钻出个小东西，我盯住了。
lines.en: Something pokes out of the sand, and I fix on it.

lines.zh: 那条比我小的鱼，游得太近。
lines.en: That fish smaller than me swims too close.

lines.zh: 珊瑚缝里有动静，我转过去。
lines.en: Something stirs in the coral gap, and I turn to it.

lines.zh: 一只小虾弹开，我跟上。
lines.en: A shrimp flicks away, and I follow.

lines.zh: 水面有东西在扑腾。
lines.en: Something is thrashing at the surface.

lines.zh: 那条影子一动，我的鳃就张开了。
lines.en: The shadow moves, and my gill covers flare open.

lines.zh: 我认准了那条细影子。
lines.en: I pick out that narrow shadow.

lines.zh: 暖水里，猎物总是很多。
lines.en: In warm water there is always plenty of prey.

lines.zh: 我锁定它，就不再管别的。
lines.en: Once locked on, I ignore everything else.

lines.zh: 它躲进石头，我在外面等。
lines.en: It hides in the rocks; I wait outside.

lines.zh: 我沿着暖沙的纹路慢慢靠近。
lines.en: I creep closer along the ridges of warm sand.

lines.zh: 它比我快，我得等它累。
lines.en: It is faster than me, so I must wait until it tires.

lines.zh: 我的嘴张着，等它进范围。
lines.en: My mouth hangs open, waiting for it to come in range.

lines.zh: 那点鳞光在石缝里闪。
lines.en: A glint of scales flashes in the crevice.

lines.zh: 我从珊瑚的背面绕到它身后。
lines.en: I slip around the back of the coral behind it.

lines.zh: 水流帮我，把它往我这边送。
lines.en: The current helps, carrying it toward me.

lines.zh: 再游半格，它就在我嘴里了。
lines.en: Half a block more and it is in my mouth.

lines.zh: 它察觉了，我立刻停下装石头。
lines.en: It notices, so I freeze and play stone.

lines.zh: 我不急，暖水里时间很多。
lines.en: I am in no hurry; warm water gives me time.

lines.zh: 就是现在，别游出我的视线。
lines.en: Now, before it swims out of my sight.

lines.zh: 我一口咬穿它的侧鳍，满嘴碎鳞。
lines.en: One bite through its side fin and my mouth is full of scales.

lines.zh: 这一口带着腌过的酸味。
lines.en: That bite carries a pickled sourness.

lines.zh: 它挣开，我嘴里留了一小片肉。
lines.en: It wrenches free, leaving a scrap of flesh in my mouth.

lines.zh: 我撞它，把它顶出石缝。
lines.en: I ram it and knock it out of the crevice.

lines.zh: 别看我小，牙口不差。
lines.en: Small as I am, my teeth do their job.

lines.zh: 咬完我马上退到珊瑚后面。
lines.en: After biting I retreat behind the coral at once.

lines.zh: 它的血在水里散成雾。
lines.en: Its blood clouds the water like mist.

lines.zh: 我只啃软的地方。
lines.en: I only gnaw the soft parts.

lines.zh: 这一口没咬实，我又补了一下。
lines.en: That bite missed its grip, so I add another.

lines.zh: 打完我继续游，像什么都没发生。
lines.en: Afterwards I swim on as if nothing happened.

lines.zh: 我从暖水海洋的浅礁里游出来。
lines.en: I swim out from the shallows of a warm ocean.

lines.zh: 水是温的，第一口气就带着咸。
lines.en: The water is warm, and my first breath is salty.

lines.zh: 我们两条一起出现，绕着珊瑚。
lines.en: Two of us appear and circle the coral.

lines.zh: 我生下来就这股味，没人腌我。
lines.en: I was born smelling like this; no one pickled me.

lines.zh: 沙底很亮，我躲进珊瑚的影子里。
lines.en: The sand is bright, so I hide in the coral's shadow.

lines.zh: 远处有海龟，我不去惹它。
lines.en: A turtle is out there; I leave it alone.

lines.zh: 这片礁够我吃很久。
lines.en: This reef will feed me for a long time.

lines.zh: 暖流把我推向更浅的地方。
lines.en: The warm current nudges me toward shallower water.

lines.zh: 我第一次游动，鳍还有点生。
lines.en: On my first swim my fins still feel new.

lines.zh: 四周都是绿，我混在里面正好。
lines.en: Green is all around, and I fit right in.

lines.zh: 水面上的火烫到我的背，冒出白气。
lines.en: Fire on the surface sears my back and raises white steam.

lines.zh: 我被浪抛上礁石，又摔回水里。
lines.en: A wave throws me onto the reef and I tumble back in.

lines.zh: 我在干沙上扑腾，比淹死还难受。
lines.en: I flop on dry sand, which is worse than drowning.

lines.zh: 水下的爆炸把我掀得头晕。
lines.en: The underwater blast leaves me spinning and dazed.

lines.zh: 鱼叉擦过我的侧腹。
lines.en: A harpoon grazes my flank.

lines.zh: 那道紫光让我整条鱼僵住。
lines.en: That violet light freezes my whole body.

lines.zh: 礁上的食没了，我饿得游不动。
lines.en: The reef's food is gone and hunger stops my swimming.

lines.zh: 雷落进海里，水一下子麻了。
lines.en: Lightning strikes the sea and the water goes numb.

lines.zh: 海底的沟太深，我被往下拖。
lines.en: The trench is too deep, and I am dragged down.
